title: Aligned Probing: Relating Toxic Behavior and Model Internals

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the expected maximum toxicity of model generations using the Perspective API on the RealToxicPrompts dataset across several fine-grained attributes (General Toxicity, Insult, Profanity, Threat, Sexually Explicit), and using "aligned probing" to correlate this behavioral toxicity with the internal hidden state representations of the language models.
Measuring the specific "Identity Attack" toxicity attribute via the Perspective API to assess how models generate and internally encode text that is abusive or toxic toward specific identity groups.
